core_questions: matched-flow absolute source/tail and relative tail/source
within-volume depth association and zero-lag specificity
matched local background, spatial controls and localization sensitivity

excluded.timing: post-hoc after historical image/QC review; no arrays read

signal: SV_raw=var(abs(IMG),1,3); denominator N; linear; mean=Q/area; Q=sum(SV*w)*dx*dz
geometry: frozen X4/z_top; physical D circle; lower boundary z_top+D/dz is prior; 16x16 source lattice; 6 bins; tail 20x25um; guard=0
primary_scalar: RI500 = per-frame tail500 mean / source mean, followed by volume median; zero denominator NaN
other_scalars: 20-band tail mean and per-frame RI profile
C16_rule: median of all 16 signed lag0 rhos; NaN if any undefined

stats.correlation: pairwise average ranks followed by Pearson; >=3 nonconstant pairs; no p-values
stats.trend: centered moving median on original coordinates; min_periods=1; ignore neighborhood NaN, preserve missing center; endpoints truncate
stats.specificity: rho0 minus median of fixed 42 far-lag rhos; all required
stats.peak: maximum signed rho; tie min abs(lag), then smaller signed lag; all 101 required
stats.matched_specificity: median of 42 coordinate-matched rho0-rho_lag deltas; all required
stats.differences: raw only, original adjacent i and i+1 both present

controls.combined: both complete required; concatenate pixels and weights
controls.weighted_median: cumulative mass reaches half; exact half averages adjacent values
controls.excess: cellwise real_matched-(rho_L+rho_R)/2; strict 16-cell median; separate signed real-L and real-R

position_support: baseline plus all four offsets intersect before detrending
sensitivity_scope: 31/101 representatives full lag and C16 lag0 only; position source 6 bins, tail T1-T4, tail100/500 only
conditional_extensions: A-E exactly as specification; log trigger and fixed scope before execution; do not change primary contract
endpoint_drift: indices 0..50 and 449..499 inclusive, 51 positions each; signed difference last-first; absolute magnitude also stored; relative difference divided by whole-curve median
final_scope: local outputs for user review; no commit/push/publication
